title: Pasaklı Cadı
author: Oylum Yılmaz
description: Messy’s greatest dream is to become a witch, then she could fly, talk to animals and never have to tidy her room again! Her most treasured possession is The Witches of Büyükada, a mysterious book inherited from her mother that contains the island witches’ secrets, spells and hidden gatherings. But where have all the witches gone, and why have Messy’s parents disappeared? Joined by her best friends Seli and Tete, she sets out to uncover the truth, encountering enigmatic trees, challenging riddles, strange clues, hidden powers, allies concealed in the shadows and sinister creatures known as the Silikler.
